svg.title: G2 System design: integrated process map
svg.desc: Process map of phase G2 System design: DES-01 System requirements (Joint, after nothing); DES-02 Mechanical, structural and stability analysis (Electrical & mechanical, after nothing); DES-03 Safety requirements specification (Safety-related control, after DES-01); DES-04 Response time, fall-arrest and stopping budget (Safety-related control, after DES-02); DES-05 Stop chain and safety-related control architecture (Safety-related control, after DES-03, DES-04); DES-06 Safety chain I/O interface (Safety-related control, after DES-05); DES-07 Requirements for installation, operation and maintenance (Joint, after DES-03); DES-08 Cybersecurity architecture (Cybersecurity, after DES-05); DES-09 System FMEA (Safety-related control, after DES-06); DES-10 Fault tree analysis (Safety-related control, after DES-09); DES-11 Common cause failure analysis (Safety-related control, after DES-09); DES-12 STPA of the motion control chain (Joint, after DES-06); DES-13 Independence of the safety chain from the policy and tele-operation stack (Safety-related control, after DES-08, DES-12); DES-14 Update the hazard log and the safety case (Joint, after DES-09, DES-13).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
